nodes.label: Gap analysis: inbound заявка → draft КП (front of the wedge)
instant-assign-notification pattern (wave W1)
nodes.rationale: Benchmark pattern shared by Odoo, Bitrix24 and Salesforce: the assignee learns of a new lead instantly (popup/counter/email alert). Before W1 the seller learned of a заявка ONLY via in-app bell + WebSocket (_notify_seller_team) — an offline seller never knew until they logged in; the 42-hour B2B median response comes from exactly such places. W1: email to the routed seller team mirroring the existing in-app notification (platform-branded internal mail, no white-label, no new settings), plus the same email on targeted assign_deal.

nodes.label: one-click-quotation pattern (wave W2, Odoo New Quotation)
nodes.rationale: Odoo's New Quotation button creates a prefilled quotation from the opportunity in one click, stage does not gate. Before W2 the path took 4–6 manual actions on 2 screens (claim → Kanban-drag SOURCING → CALCULATING → 'Сформировать КП' created an EMPTY КП → open builder → 'AI-черновик'). W2: one button 'Взять в работу и подготовить КП' = claim + FSM auto-run through the chain (without breaking the FSM, like Move 0 auto-transitions) + КП created WITH copied request lines + immediate AI draft for ai.draft-entitled sellers. The empty-КП manual path was demoted to a bug and also fixed (prefill_created_quote). Live run later exposed a seam defect the spec did not foresee: the builder showed items of ALL the deal's documents because request lines live in a separate Quote and W2 creates a second document (#563).

nodes.label: aging-counters pattern (wave W3, Bitrix24)
nodes.rationale: Bitrix24-style age counters: 'ждёт N ч' on unclaimed заявки in the dashboard strip and request list, from already-stored created_at/assigned_at. Explicitly NOT a new gate and NOT an SLA block (PRODUCT RULE 2 — visibility for the руководитель only), and explicitly optional at the owner's discretion. Before it, assigned_at was written 'for time-to-first-touch' but surfaced nowhere.

nodes.label: Speed-to-lead economics
nodes.rationale: Why the front of the wedge matters: responding in 5 minutes = 9× conversion probability (Salesforce); slipping from 5 to 30 minutes = −21× to qualification (MIT/InsideSales); B2B median response is 42 hours — a losing number. The maximum 'difference between manual and automated work' (the platform's stated goal) lives at the ENTRY of the wedge: заявка lands → seller learns → КП is born as a draft.

edges.source_location: note on #563 — defect at the seam between documents, same failure class as agent-seam bugs
